dedupe_keys.name: liste des passages a niveau voies ferrees rdt13

description: Liste des passages à niveau (voies ferrées RDT13) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Régie Départementale des Transports des Bouches du Rhône. List of grade crossings of two secondary railway lines This dataset lists the level crossings of two railway lines located in the Bouches du Rhône department: the line fromArles to Fontvieille and the line from Pas-des-Lanciers to La Mède. The types of grade crossings are specified in the attached file. Coverage: Régie Départementale des Transports des Bouches du Rhône. The portal shows the English title as "List of grade crossings (RDT13)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Régie Départementale des Transports des Bouches du Rhône. Its keywords include passage-a-niveau, bouches-du-rhone, passages-a-niveau. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
